test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The mean of 70 items was 32. Later, it was discovered that two items were misread as 64 and 28 instead of 46 and 81.

The correct mean is:
solution:
**Given:**

The mean of 70 items was 32

Misread numbers are 64 and 28 instead of 46 and 81

**Concept used:**

Mean = Sum of elements/No. of elements

**Calculation:**

Total of all numbers = 70 × 32

⇒ 2240

Actual total of all numbers = 2240 - 64 - 28 + 46 + 81

⇒ 2275

Actual mean = 2275/70 = 32.5

**∴ The correct mean is 32.5**
